notes.title: Our New Trailer is Finally Here!
notes.content: [p]After 3 months of hard work, we’re excited to share our brand-new trailer with you! In it, you’ll get a glimpse of the current state of gameplay and how it’s shaping up.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="S8bp5s0FfAQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]We’re really happy to finally show you how the game is taking shape, and we’d love to hear what you think so far.[/p][p][/p][p]Your feedback means a lot to us![/p]

notes.title: The Gateway to Humanity’s Next Chapter
notes.content:
[p]Designed by the greatest mind of Astra Industria, the Astra Gate is a colossal, interstellar construct capable of folding space itself. In [i]Astra Industria[/i], your ultimate mission is not just to mine, build, and automate, but to assemble this technological marvel piece by piece.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45666867/0ce3728b2ee34ad69f9d72fc25c1073d50446676.png"][/img]
Building it won’t be easy. You’ll need to assemble a fully automated industrial empire and extract the rarest resources scattered across the galaxy. But once activated, the Astra Gate opens the path to a new era of humanity, a step beyond the stars.[/p][p][/p][p]What do you think? Will you be the first one to complete this monumental project?[/p]
